Job Title: Marketing Operations Coordinator (Co-op)
Company: Hollowell Retail Group
Location: Mississauga, ON
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
Work Term: Fall 2027
Duration: 4 months
Salary: $25.50 per hour
Application Deadline: 2027-05-14

About the Role

The Marketing Operations Coordinator will support campaign operations and marketing
automation workflows across our retail banners.

Responsibilities

- Build and QA email campaigns in the marketing automation platform
- Maintain campaign calendars and lead routing rules
- Support marketing operations reporting for the demand generation team
